verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback capture is limited to an explicit widget that users must press to submit a report (foreloop-docs-9, foreloop-docs-18, foreloop-docs-29), routed into a feedback list or project (foreloop-docs-11). There is no evidence of any integration or automatic ingestion from sales calls, support tickets, or chat conversations — the story's specific channels are entirely unaddressed. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The story requires AUTOMATIC capture from sales calls, support tickets, and chat; the only intake evidenced is a manual end-user widget, and the Opus rationale concedes nothing shows capture from any of the named channels. The story's qualifiers exclude the credited evidence. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
